name: Orbkit
summary: WebGL shader orbs for React via shadcn registry; MIT original orbs for agent states.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 14 MIT original orbs (shdr-32 Galaxy and shdr-33 Thermal omitted to keep 12).
19 XorDev-ported orbs are non-commercial-with-attribution — excluded (CREDITS.md / LICENSE-SHADERS.md).
Library markets overall as free for non-commercial; LICENSE + original orbs are MIT — catalog license string is MIT for ingested comps only.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Hydrogen
components.summary: Quantum orbital orb with rainbow chromatic bands over dark metal.

demo.peerNotes: shadcn registry install; WebGL 1; zero npm deps beyond React. Client component (orbkit-core).

components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add zzzzshawn/orbkit/shdr-11
# or: npx shadcn@latest add https://orbkit.zzzzshawn.cloud/r/shdr-11.json

import { Shdr11 } from "@/components/ui/shdr-11"

<Shdr11 size={320} state="idle" />

copyPrompt.text: Use Orbkit free MIT React WebGL orb `Hydrogen` (slug `shdr-11`, export `Shdr11`) from https://orbkit.zzzzshawn.cloud/playground?orb=shdr-11. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add zzzzshawn/orbkit/shdr-11` (or `npx shadcn@latest add https://orbkit.zzzzshawn.cloud/r/shdr-11.json`). Files land in `@/components/ui/shdr-11.tsx` plus shared `@/components/ui/orbkit-core.tsx`. Drive with state="idle"|"thinking"|"speaking". Home: https://orbkit.zzzzshawn.cloud. Docs: https://orbkit.zzzzshawn.cloud/getting-started/usage. Repo: https://github.com/zzzzshawn/orbkit.
